tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_arc_warden_tempest_:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.

The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Power Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Level 1 - Arcane Rune.

Level 2 - Arcane and Invisibility Runes.

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.
Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.
Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.

The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_arc_warden_bio:
Before the beginning of all, there existed a presence: a primordial mind, infinite, awesome, and set to inscrutable purpose. As the universe thundered into being, this mind was fragmented and scattered. Two among its greater fragments--who would come to be named Radiant and Dire--found themselves locked in vicious opposition, and began twisting all of creation to serve their conflict.

As war and cataclysm threatened the nascent cosmos, the will of a third fragment made itself known. Naming itself Zet, this intellect sought to resolve the disharmony and return all to perfect unity. Appalled by its kin's conflicting nature, Zet gathered the sum of its power. In a sudden flash, it overwhelmed its siblings, and fused the warring aspects into a stellar sphere before hurling them into the darkness to orbit a nondescript world. Harmony was restored, though only the barest fraction of Zet's strength remained. Setting its gaze on the prison, Zet chose to use its weakened power to serve as watchful warden until time's end. For uncounted aeons, this vigil stood.

Life flourished upon the world below, oblivious to the dangers imprisoned within the softly glowing moon, or of Zet's struggles to contain them. As the captives' eternal clash reverberated within, the surface of the prison shuddered, over time beginning to crack. Ultimately, Zet's depleted power proved insufficient to contain the breach, and at last the moon was shattered. The prison's ancient inhabitants had escaped to sow their conflict anew.

Flung to the farthest reaches by the prison's explosion, Zet was transformed by the dissonant energies of its former captives. No longer of single form and thought, its presence had become split among many--some lesser, some greater--each connected by a fleeting arc of consciousness. Struggling to suppress its own disunity, Zet sped toward the burgeoning conflict of its siblings, bending its fractured wills toward a singular conclusion: the aspects of the primordial mind must be made to reunite, or all must be destroyed lest the conflict spread further...
tokens.npc_dota_hero_arc_warden_hype: A splintered fragment of the same primordial power as the Ancients themselves, Zet the Arc Warden has pledged to see the clash between Radiant and Dire finally end. Assault lone enemies with fluxing energy, or distort space to generate a protective field around allies. Summon a Spark Wraith to patrol an area for enemies to infuse with harmful magic, then create a double of Zet, items and all, to overwhelm your foes.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: An infinitesimal fraction of the power which imprisoned the Ancients.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Deals damage over time on the unit-targeted enemy.

The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the debuff-affected enemy unit.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Additionally silences the lone enemy unit.

Increases damage per second and duration.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Flux: Taking damage when not near a friendly unit and slowed by x%.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has two main componenets:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|arc_warden_flux}}
*** Checks for valid enemy units centered around the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy, in {{#var:Flux basic1}}-second intervals upon cast, the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} immediately activates or disables correspondingly on the checks.
**** Considers the following enemy units as valid units:
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} The enemy's allied units.
***** {{M|Neutral creeps}}.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
**** Does not consider the following enemy units as valid units:
***** {{M|Buildings}}
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
**** {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}
***** Deals {{calc|v1*{{#var:Flux basic1}}|v1={{#var:Flux value2}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Flux basic1}}|v1={{#var:Flux value2 agh}}}}|agh}}) [[magical]] [[spell damage]] ([[before reductions]]) in {{#var:Flux basic1}}-second intervals, over {{#expr:{{#var:Flux value4}}/{{#var:Flux basic1}}+1}} ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Flux value4 agh}}/{{#var:Flux basic1}}+1}}|agh}}) possible instances for the entire duration.
***** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
****** When the spell damage per second component can no longer apply, certain ability effects on the target disappears, with a red glow remaining on the affected unit, indicating the debuff is still active with the damage component disabled.
*** The following sources do not update the current debuff instance applied:
**** Leveling up the ability.
**** Learning the {{ValueColor||movement speed slow increasing|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}}.
**** Acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}}.
*** Reapplying the debuff applies another independent instance.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|arc_warden_flux_alone}}
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} Checks for valid centered around the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy within the same intervals upon cast, the {{M|silence}} component immediately activates or disables correspondingly on the checks.
*** Reapplying the debuff applies another independent instance.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
The Self creates a perfect duplication of itself which is considered a hero by most abilities.

The Double can use all of The Self's current items and non-ultimate spells, except most consumables and items that would drop on death.

The Double has a separate and independent item and ability cooldowns.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Increases The Double's gold and experience bounty value per Arc Warden's level.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: The Double loses its sense of self as it nears its expire duration.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Grants the Tempest Double the {{Rune|Arcane}} buff, the {{Rune|Haste}} buff, and the {{Rune|Invisibility}} buff when created.

fields.name: interacts
buff1text
fields.value: Tempest Double: A complete clone of Arc Warden that can use spells and items with the exception of Gem of True Sight and Divine Rapier.

fields.name: buff3text
fields.value: Fracturing: Losing sense of Self. Slowed by X%. Attacks have a X% chance to miss.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities: 
** {{M|Doubletap}} spawns The Double next to The Self.
** {{Symbol|Target|Point}} Respawns The Double at the point-targeted location with the same {{M|facing angle}} as The Self.

[[File:Dota2 Arc Warden Tempest Double HUD.png|250px|thumb|The currently selected unit is highlighted.]]

* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
** The Double is visually distinguishable from the Self to everyone.
** The minimap displays {{M|The Double|text=a unique minimap icon|x}} and {{M|The Self|text=Arc Warden's default minimap icon|x}} for allied heroes and enemy heroes respectively.

* {{Symbol|Clone}}
** {{M|The Double}} has the following properties:
*** Creates a [[clone]] with {{M|The Self}}'s current {{M|health}} and current {{M|mana}} upon the first cast in the game.
*** Subsequent ability casts merely respawn The Double with the following ability effects applied:
**** Applies a {{M|death dispel}}.
**** Does not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
**** Neither refreshes current ability nor item {{M|cooldowns}}.
**** Setting the Double's current {{M|health}} and current {{M|mana}} equivalent to the caster's.
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} Grants The Double the following [[Power Rune]] buffs
**** {{Rune|Arcane}} [[File:Dota2 Plus Scale icon.png|21px]] {{Rune|Haste}} [[File:Dota2 Plus Scale icon.png|21px]] {{Rune|Invisibility}}
**** The Power Runes' respective notes apply.
** {{Symbol|Experience}}
*** The Double is not considered a valid unit for the [[Experience#Acquiring Experience|experience gain]] radius. 
*** As a result, Arc Warden cannot earn Experience through the Double, with two exceptions:
**** Killing a hero with the Double (since hero kills always provide XP globally to the killer).
**** Taking a [[Shrine of Wisdom]] with the Double grants the XP to Arc Warden instead.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
*** The following permanent consumed buffs are granted to The Double:
**** {{I|Moon Shard}}'s [[Moon Shard#Cosume|Consume]]
**** {{I|Aghanim's Blessing}}'s [[Aghanim's Blessing#Ability Upgrade|Upgrade]]
**** {{A|Alchemist|Aghanim's Scepter Synth}}
**** {{I|Aghanim's Shard}}
*** Other permanent bonuses granted to The Double do not persist upon its {{M|death}}.
*** Abilities that grant bonus stacks per kill do not grant stacks upon killing The Double.

* {{Symbol|Blind}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|tempest_double_}}
** [[Evasion#Stacking|Stacks]] additively with other [[blind]] sources and multiplicatively with {{M|evasion}} sources.
** The Double's miss chance uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Tempest Double type2 value1}}}}

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
The Double neither can pick up, nor drop items. However, it can utilize item abilities within its inventory with each item having an independent cooldown of The Self's.

Upon each cast, The Double's inventory is updated based on The Self's. This sets all items' attributes as well.

Does not copy muted items in The Self's inventory.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: [[Bash]] sources are passively disabled on The Double.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: [[Black King Bar]]'s ability duration reduces per cast and is bound independently to The Double.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: [[Aeon Disk]]'s ability cooldown increases per proc and is bound independently to The Double.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: Everlasting items are not copied by The Double.

fields.name: desc5
fields.value: Most consumable items are not copied by The Double.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Cooldown}}
** Items in The Self's inventory that are still unusable due to the {{M|backpack}} delay will be immediately available for The Double upon summon.
** Procs {{A|Refresher Orb|Reset Cooldowns}}' cooldown upon summon.

* Can utilize the following mechanics:
** The following item sources grants The Self all bonuses upon cast or upon proc:
*** {{A|Hand of Midas|Transmute}}
*** {{A|Desolator|Corruption}} stacks.
** {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} and {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}}
*** Set the [[toggle]]-able item abilities based on The Self's toggle status.
** {{M|Neutral Items|text=Artifacts}}, except the following sources:
*** {{A|Mind Breaker|Silence Strike}}

* For {{I|Power Treads}} and {{I|Vambrace}}:
** Sets the item to the selected attribute based on The Self's.
** Both items' active ability functions independently.

* For both {{I|Helm of the Dominator}}-based items:
** If The Self is not wielding the same item, The Double's corresponding [[Dominate]] goes on cooldown upon {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeting the creep, and does nothing.

* Cannot utilize the following mechanics:
** [[Consumable]] {{M|buffs}} and items, except {{I|Town Portal Scroll}}.
** Item-based {{M|Bash}} sources.
** [[Item Sharing]].
** {{I|Urn of Shadows}}-based items.
*** Neither gain nor copy The Self's charges.
** The following items are not copied:
*** {{I|Aegis of the Immortal}}
*** {{I|Divine Rapier}}
*** {{I|Gem of True Sight}}

abilities: Tempest Double clones Arc Warden and his items to double his damage from afar.
Arc is weak and farm-reliant early, so aggressive ganks shut him down before items.
items: Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Arc Warden's magic damage and disables.
Mjollnir / Maelstrom's chain lightning clears Arc Warden's summons.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Arc Warden's physical attacks.
Glimmer Cape's magic resistance and fade help dodge Arc Warden's burst.
Assault Cuirass's armor aura blunts Arc Warden's physical damage.
A silencing burst with true strike and crit.
An ability upgrade for extra utility.
A dispel plus illusions and attack speed.
